name: non-shortest-heads-re-encoded
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.28 (the cbor wire): packs/dtn-bpv7/pack.def and pack.md; RFC 9171 4.1 (bundle), 4.3.1 (primary block), 4.3.2 (canonical block), 4.2.1 (CRC); Reading step 2: the sequence number 5 in a two-byte head (190005), the lifetime 3600000 in an eight-byte head (1b000000000036ee80), and the payload block number 1 in a one-byte head (1801, residue). The CRCs in the input (primary CRC-16 8274, payload CRC-16 b7a3) are computed over those bytes. Writing step 1 writes 05, 1a0036ee80 and 01 and carries the CRC values unchanged; over the re-encoded blocks the CRCs would be 6e8f and dbeb, so both no longer match (ruling 1 of 0.28; pack.md, Output). The wire does not check CRCs. Derived without an engine by a standalone RFC 8949 codec.
